harnessCorrection: The first strict synthetic accessory assertion failed with an accessory parented directly to the avatar. Focused 23 and final full 47 checks passed.

timingQualification: Observed impact never preceded configured windup. Scheduling may delay an impact; final Stalker observation ~0.439 s vs configured 0.28 s. No upper latency or FPS guarantee.
inputQualification: Dodges prepared by controlled server character movement with anchored roots, not native keyboard/touch. Real director and actual character respawn exercised.
